⚠⚠ **本層擋下策展層最大的一處正文風險：〈Festival Journey〉不是 Max Roach 寫的。** **Discogs 1110614（1996 美國原壓 CD）的逐軌 credit 逐字寫死**：〈Festival Journey〉**`Frederick Tillis — Composed By`**、**`David Epstein — Conductor`**、`Stephanie Rogers — Engineer`、**`Max Roach — Soloist, Drums`**——**Roach 在這一軌的身分是「獨奏者」，作曲與指揮都是別人。** 〈Ghost Dance〉那一軌的 credit 才是另一組人：**`Max Roach — Drums [Trap]`、`Marshall Sealy — French Horn`、`Steve Turre — Trombone`、`Cecil Bridgewater — Trumpet`、`Frank Gordon — Trumpet`、`Bob Stewart — Tuba`**——**五件銅管 ＋ 一套鼓，這才是盤名裡的 So What Brass Quintet。** 全碟 credit 另有 `Max Roach — Producer`、`Bruce Lundvall — Executive Producer`、`Max Roach — Liner Notes`、`Allan Tucker — Mastered By`、`Patrick Roques — Design`、`Chuck Stewart／Susan J. Ross — Photography`。

⚠ **這張碟不是一天錄完的，兩軌差了將近兩年、地點也不同。** **Discogs 1110614 的 notes 逐字**：「"Festival Journey" was recorded on **December 2, 1993 at the University of Massachusetts, Amherst.**」「"Ghost Dance" recorded on **October 5, 1995 at the Sound On Sound Studio, New York City.**」companies 欄與之一致：`Recorded At: University Of Massachusetts`、`Recorded At: Sound On Sound, New York`、`Mixed At: Sound Mirror, Jamaica Plain, MA`、`Mixed At: Sound On Sound, New York`、`Mastered At: Foothill Digital`、`Glass Mastered At: EMI MFG.`、℗© `Capitol Records, Inc.`。**正文不得寫成一次錄音，也不得把兩軌寫成同一批人。**

⚠ **紙本是本組最厚的一筆，而且 Billboard 自己就把作曲者寫死了。** **Billboard 1996-04-20 p1 頭版導言 ＋ p60 全文（Jim Macnie，標題「BLUE NOTE'S ROACH GETS ORCHESTRAL」）**：發行時點逐字「"Max Roach With The New Orchestra Of Boston & The So What Brass **Ensemble**," **slated for worldwide release through EMI on Tuesday (16)**」＝**1996-04-16 全球街頭日**；曲目描述逐字「Anchored by a **50-minute piece titled "Festival Journey,"** it features the virtuoso percussionist **soloing through three movements** that collectively conjure both **Dvoiik**[Dvořák]**and Ellington**, with evocative subtitles, such as **"Outbursts," "Drones," and "Strutting."**」；作曲歸屬逐字「**"Festival Journey" was composed by Fred Tillis.** He and Roach struck up a relationship at the **University of Massachusetts** when the drummer taught there in the '80s.」；Roach 談 Tillis 逐字「Fred's from Texas, plays a hell of a tenor, and has that raw-boned thing the Southern tenors are known for」。

同一篇 Billboard 1996-04-20 p60 把〈Ghost Dance〉的身分也寫死：逐字「**"Ghost Dance," the 12-minute piece by the So What Brass Band that closes the disc, is the work of a wholly separate unit** that Roach hopes to develop over the next few years, **similar to his work with the Uptown String Quartet in the '80s.**」；生涯定位逐字「Roach's excursion is **his first recording done under contract for a U.S. label since his stint with Columbia in the late '70s.** The drummer spent much of the '80s recording for the **Milan-based Soul Note label**」（並舉 In The Light／Bright Moments／Survivors 三張）；Bruce Lundvall（Blue Note 總裁、當年把 Roach 簽進 Columbia 的人）逐字「Max is one of the originators of contemporary jazz, and he's still playing like he has always played: great … **He may be in his 70s, but in terms of spirit and direction, I find him to be the youngest guy on the roster.**」；行銷副總 Tom Evered 逐字「We're going right to **classical and jazz radio and classical and jazz retail**, too … 〈Festival Journey〉could go to eclectic classical stations, while〈Ghost Dance〉has more of a jazz feel」。**另記：Roach 同月 16–21 日在紐約 Iridium 演出、自傳交 Simon and Schuster、1995 年曾以 M'Boom 辦打擊峰會（Ginger Baker、Tony Williams）。**

⚠ **「Duets」是逐軌換人的企劃盤，十軌十組不同的客座——不是一支樂團。** **Discogs 3780032 的逐軌 `Featuring` credit**：**1〈Da Boardwalk〉Harvey Mason（vibraphone）**；**2〈Reunited〉Earl Klugh（acoustic guitar）**；**3〈Wind Beneath My Strings〉Tom Scott（alto sax／bass clarinet）＋ Najee（soprano sax）＋ Gerald Albright（tenor sax）**；**4〈Soulful Strut〉Ray Parker Jr.（guitar）＋ Kirk Whalum（tenor sax）**；**5〈People Get Ready〉Ali-Ollie Woodson（lead vocals）＋ The Katinas（backing vocals）**；**6〈Knighttime〉Joe Sample（keyboards）＋ Wilton Felder（tenor sax）＋ George Bohanon（trombone）**；**7〈Where Is the Love〉Howard Hewett ＋ Jasmin（lead vocals）**；**8〈Let's Start Again〉Tim Owens ＋ Sharlotte Gibson（lead vocals）**；**9〈End to a Perfect Day〉Najee（flute）**；**10〈Short and Suite〉George Duke（clavinet）＋ Alphonse Mouzon（drums）＋ Sheila E.（percussion）＋ Kevin Toney（piano/organ）＋ Jeff Lorber（mini moog）**。**製作人逐軌不同**（Cornelius Mims 1/6/8、Ollie Brown 2/4/5/7 並掛 Executive-Producer、Fortune Reed 3、Cedric ＋ Victor Caldwell 5、James Allen 8、Paul Jackson Jr. 3/6/8-10）。**鼓手也逐軌不同**（Ollie Brown 2/4/7、Jim Blair 5、Harvey Mason 6、Michael White 9、Alphonse Mouzon 10，另有 1、8 是程式鼓）。

⚠ **十軌不是一個錄音室錄的，notes 逐軌把錄音地點列出來**：逐字「All Tracks Recorded at **Mankind Recording Studios**／Track 2 Recorded at **Studio A, Detroit**／Track 5 Recorded at **Father's Image, Brentwood, TN**／Track 6 Recorded at **Trax Recording, Studio Cats**／Track 8 Recorded at **C-Note Music Studios**／Track 9 Recorded at **Fat Planet Studios**／Track 10 Recorded at **Trax Recording Studio**／All tracks mixed at **Devonshire Recording Studio**」。**另有一整段「Courtesy of」聲明，逐字列出十二家外借客座的唱片公司**（Arista／Atlantic／Caliber／Columbia／EMI／GRP／Ichiban／Motown／Sweet Basil-Pony Canyon／Tenacious／Verve／Warner Brothers）——**客座橫跨十二家公司，是「企劃盤」最直接的證據。**

⚠ **作曲：十軌裡只有四首是 Jackson 自己寫的，其餘是靈魂樂與流行的老歌。** Discogs 逐軌 `Written-By`：Jackson 自己四首（〈Da Boardwalk〉〈Knighttime〉〈End To A Perfect Day〉〈Short And Suite〉）＋ 合寫一首（〈Wind Beneath My Strings〉，與 Fortune Reed、Todd Burns）；外來曲：**〈Reunited〉Dino Fekaris／Freddie Perren**（Peaches & Herb 1979 冠軍曲）、**〈Soulful Strut〉Eugene Record／Sonny Sanders**（Young-Holt Unlimited 1968）、**〈People Get Ready〉Curtis Mayfield**、**〈Where Is The Love〉Ralph MacDonald／William Salter**（Roberta Flack & Donny Hathaway 1972）、**〈Let's Start Again〉Cornelius Mims／Michael Norfleet／Terri McFaddin**。

BLUE NOTE 37630 /CAPITOL NEVER ALONE/DUETS**」，同榜第 22 是 David Sanborn《The Best Of David Sanborn》）。**(2) 評介**：**Billboard 1996-07-27 p81 的 JAZZ 評介欄逐字「PAUL JACKSON JR./Never Alone—Duets／PRODUCERS various／Blue Note 37630／Veteran L.A. session guitarist Paul Jackson Jr. swims in diverse waters on a set that features instrumental and vocal collaborations with such jazz favorites as Tom Scott, Earl Klugh, Joe …」**——**「PRODUCERS various」逐字印在評介抬頭上，與 Discogs 的逐軌製作人名單吻合。** **(3) 現場**：同年另一頁的圖說逐字「**Guitars All Around.** Paul Jackson Jr. stands with fellow guitarists after his recent performance at **B.B. King's Blues Club in Los Angeles.** The gig served as the launch point for "Never Alone/D[uets]"」——**發片現場在洛杉磯的 B.B. King's Blues Club。**

sound: 十軌的二重奏企劃盤，Paul Jackson, Jr. 的電吉他是唯一貫穿全碟的聲音，其餘每一軌都換人。編制隨客座變：第一軌是 Harvey Mason 的鐵琴，第二軌是 Earl Klugh 的原聲吉他，第三軌一次來三支薩克斯（Tom Scott、Najee、Gerald Albright），第六軌是 Joe Sample 的鍵盤加 Wilton Felder 的次中音，末軌〈Short and Suite〉擠進五位客座（George Duke 的 clavinet、Alphonse Mouzon 的鼓、Sheila E. 的打擊、Kevin Toney 的鋼琴與管風琴、Jeff Lorber 的 mini moog）。三軌有主唱。曲長都在四到六分之間，沒有長曲。四首是 Jackson 自己寫的，其餘是〈Reunited〉〈Soulful Strut〉〈People Get Ready〉〈Where Is the Love〉這類靈魂樂老歌的重編。十軌散在七個錄音室錄，最後在 Devonshire 統一混音。

sound: 十軌的管風琴四重奏：Önder Focan 的吉他、Sam Yahel 的 Hammond 管風琴（兼管低音線，所以團裡沒有貝斯手）、Bill Stewart 的鼓、John Nugent 的次中音薩克斯。曲長落差大，最長的〈Grey Haired Waltzer (Kır Saçlı Valsçi)〉九分四十秒，最短的〈Peshrev 2nd Part (Peşrev 2. Hane)〉只有兩分四十六秒，其餘多在五到八分之間。曲目以 Focan 的原創為主，四首掛土耳其文副題，開場的〈Denizli〉是土耳其西部城市名，〈Peşrev 2. Hane〉借的是鄂圖曼古典音樂的器樂前奏曲形式。兩首外來曲擺在頭尾附近：Jerome Kern 的〈Smoke Gets in Your Eyes〉與收尾的〈Nardis〉。實體發行有 CD、CDr 與卡帶三種。
yearVerified: **卡單 1998 成立（策展層第 1234 條把 MB frd 的 1997 改判成 1998），本層覆核並再補一層在地來源，維持 1998。** **正方四層：** (1) ⚠ **新增的一層（本層自己找的，土耳其文在地樂評）**：**TurkJazz 的本盤條目逐字「1998'in ilk günlerinde piyasaya çıkan」＝「在 1998 年的最初幾天上市」**——**這一句直接說出上市時點，而且正好解釋反向證據。** (2) **Discogs 三筆土耳其實體條目（CD 17551810／CDr 28155196／卡帶 36221833）的 `year` 與 `released` 欄全部 1998、`format` 欄全部乾淨**（策展層只找到一筆，本層找到三筆）。 (3) **英文維基 `Önder Focan` 正文逐字「In 1998 he was the first Turkish musician to record an album for Blue Note Records」，Discography 欄逐字「_Beneath the Stars_ (Blue Note, 1998)」。** (4) **土耳其在地爵士資料庫 Cazkolik 的條目逐字「Blue Note Records (EMI Müzik) | 1998」**（策展層引，本層未能重新取得該頁，保留為策展層的來源）。 **反向證據兩項，兩項都已經被解釋掉：** ⚠ **(a) MB first-release-date `1997`，而且它唯一一筆帶目錄號的 release 28e01fef 也填 1997 TR**——**第 1237 條(1) 的形狀：MB 抄的是壓片／登記年而不是鋪貨年。** ⚠ **(b) Apple `tr`／`de` 的 `releaseDate` `1997-12-25`（帶完整月日、非年頭回填）、copyright 欄逐字 `℗ 1997 Universal Music Türkiye`**——**1997-12-25 是耶誕節、不可能是土耳其的零售街頭日，配上 TurkJazz 的「1998 年頭幾天上市」，最合理的實況就是「1997 年底壓好、1998 年初鋪貨」，與策展層的推測一致。** **依簡報 §二的階序（在地同期評論 ＞ Discogs 原壓群 ＞ MB frd），1998 成立。**⚠ **紙本**：**Billboard 1997 全年（51 期）查 `Focan`／`100301`／`Beneath the Stars` 零命中**（該年 Billboard 確實有一篇 TURKISH MUSIC MARKET 專題，但沒有提到本盤）；**1998 年兩刊 repo 內都沒有人掃，本層未自抓**——**這一張的紙本層明寫查無，不是證據不足。**
